The Composite Scheme of Arrangement ("Scheme") amongst Tata Motors Limited ("Tata Motors" or "Demerged Company" or "Amalgamated Company"), TML Commercial Vehicles Limited ("TMLCV" or "Resulting Company"), Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited ("TMPV" or "Amalgamating Company"), and their respective shareholders, sanctioned under Sections 230-232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 ("the Act"), received approval from the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, via its orders dated August 25, 2025, and September 10, 2025.
Upon the said order becoming effective on October 1, 2025, the Commercial Vehicle (CV) and Passenger Vehicle (PV) businesses of the erstwhile Tata Motors Limited were demerged and housed in two distinct listed entities, namely TML Commercial Vehicles Limited (presently known as Tata Motors Limited) and Tata Motors Limited (presently known as Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited).
The Company was subsequently listed on November 12, 2025. Consequently, the reporting of compliance in the Corporate Governance (CG) report for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, reflects its applicability as a listed entity during that period.
